Sofia / Jenna — following up with the audit log and pen-test notes. See quick summary below and attached sample export.

Audit logs (owner: Grace):
- Current retention: 90 days for raw request logs, 1 year aggregated metrics (rolling) — documented in the Console > Logs export.
- Export format: gzipped JSONL with timestamp, request_id, model_id, token_count, latency_ms, routing_decision. Sample attached (audit-log-export-sample.txt).
- Action: Provide a 30-day filtered excerpt that matches Starlite's data classification by 2026-08-06.

Pen test coordination (owner: Grace, vendor Alex Tan CC'd):
- Proposed scope: external blackbox + credentialed API testing limited to staging keys (no PII).
- Tentative window: 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-21 (subject to procurement SOW).
- Requirement: signed NDA & SOW with vendor before start. I attached the draft scope (pen-test-scope.pdf).

Quoted for context:
> SOC 2: list of evidence owners for common controls, ETA for folder sharing

I'll create a Drive folder with the log excerpt and share it to jenna.morris@starlitehealth.com and procurement.

Grace O'Connor
